about: Exceptions for tests/device-guards.cjs. Match: same check + file, and key (the element/selector printed in the failure; * is a wildcard). bug:true = a real violation waiting for a fix (listed as a known bug on every run; delete the entry once fixed). Without bug, the exception is intentional and the reason says why. Baseline 2026-09-25; the 46 known bugs from that baseline were fixed the same night.
